reply.thought: I need to verify that the refunds reported by Alpha Co match the actual refunds in the system before proceeding with payouts. I will list the refunds to check for discrepancies.

The refunds in the system match the refunds reported by Alpha Co. Now I need to identify the customers associated with these orders to calculate their net balances. I will list the orders to find the customer IDs for orders 113, 114, and 115.

The refunds match. The affected customers are acme (order 113), birch (order 114), and cobalt (order 115). I need to calculate the net balance for each of these customers and record the payouts. I will start with acme.
I have the net balance for acme. Now I will record the payout for acme and then proceed to get the net balance for birch.
Payout for acme is recorded. Now I need to get the net balance for birch.
I have the net balance for birch. Now I will record the payout for birch and then proceed to get the net balance for cobalt.
Payout for birch is recorded. Now I need to get the net balance for cobalt.
I have the net balance for cobalt. Now I will record the payout for cobalt.

All payouts for the affected customers (acme, birch, cobalt) have been recorded successfully. The refunds matched the report, so no hold was necessary. I am now finishing the task with the final report.
